mods.name: Lock-End (Fabric)
mods.description: Server-side lock for the End dimension. Lock, unlock and schedule access to the End with a shared core across platforms.

## 🔒 Lock-End v4.0.0-beta

⚠️ **This is a BETA / DEVELOPMENT release.** Use it for testing and report any bugs you find.

**Requirements:** Paper or Folia 26.3+, Java 25 — plus Fabric (Loader 0.20.1+, Fabric API) or NeoForge 26.3.0.101+ mods, or a vanilla server for the datapack

### 📋 Changes since the last stable release (`v3.1.0`)

- docs: escape pipes in the command reference tables
- fix(ci): restore the checkout action in the release workflow
- fix: update checkout action in release workflow and add Neoforge launch configuration
- docs: publish the changelog and readme for the 4.0.0 multiplatform release
- docs: retire the migrated-out migration plan and keep the record in the agent docs
- ci(release): create beta releases from the migration branch
- docs(release): describe the multiplatform artifacts in the template and modrinth page
- fix(release): ship all platform artifacts and fix the version source
- ci: gate the server smoke suite on the main-line branches
- ci: rename the quality job to build
- docs(migration): record the phase 8 follow-up work
- docs(migration): tick the phase 7 and 8 tasks and update the agent instructions
- docs: document the multiplatform targets in readme and changelog
- ci: extend the workflow for the multiplatform modules
- feat(datapack): add vanilla datapack implementation
- docs(migration): tick the neoforge half of phase 6
- feat(neoforge): add initial neoforge integration
- docs(migration): mark the fabric phase verified in singleplayer
- fix(fabric): load the mod on clients so singleplayer works
- docs: record the initial fabric adapter in the agent instructions
- docs(migration): tick completed plan phases 1-5
- feat(fabric): add initial fabric integration
- refactor(paper): migrate paper adapter to shared core
- refactor(core): extract scheduling logic
- refactor(core): extract lock state management
- feat(api): introduce shared platform-independent API
- refactor: prepare multi-module gradle structure
- feat(migration): introduce multiplatform migration plan and architecture direction

### 📜 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
| ------- | ----------- | ---------- |
| `/endlock` | Toggle the End lock | `endlock.toggle` |
| `/endlock lock` | Lock the End | `endlock.admin` |
| `/endlock unlock` | Unlock the End | `endlock.admin` |
| `/endlock unlockin <time>` | Schedule unlock (e.g. 7d, 12h) | `endlock.toggle` |
| `/endlock unlockat <date> <time>` | Schedule unlock (e.g. `2026-07-01 18:00`) | `endlock.toggle` |
| `/endlock lockin <minutes>` | Schedule a future lock | `endlock.toggle` |
| `/endlock lockat <date> <time>` | Schedule a future lock at specific time | `endlock.toggle` |
| `/endlock lock in <duration>` / `unlock in <duration>` | Admin schedule aliases (e.g. `5m`, `7d`) | `endlock.admin` |
| `/endlock status` | Show current lock status | — |
| `/endlock stats` | Show plugin statistics | — |
| `/endlock test` | Test if portal blocking works | `endlock.admin` |
| `/endlock schedule status` | Show active scheduled action | `endlock.admin` |
| `/endlock schedule clear` | Clear the active schedule | `endlock.admin` |
| `/endlock history` | View recent lock/unlock history | `endlock.history` |
| `/endlock history <page> [player\|action <value>]` | Filter history by player or action | `endlock.history` |
| `/endlock undo` | Undo the last lock/unlock action | `endlock.undo` |
| `/endlock validateconfig` | Validate configuration file | `endlock.validate` |
| `/endlock pause` | Pause scheduled timers | `endlock.admin` |
| `/endlock resume` | Resume paused scheduled timers | `endlock.admin` |
| `/lock` | Alias for `/endlock` | `endlock.toggle` |
| `/el` | Short alias for `/endlock` (mobile-friendly) | `endlock.toggle` |

Commands `/endlock lock`, `/endlock unlock`, and `/endlock status` (the subset
command surface) also exist on the Fabric and NeoForge mods; the vanilla
datapack offers the same three as `/function lockend:lock|unlock|status` plus

...

### 🔌 Integrations

- **PlaceholderAPI** — `%lockend_status%`, `%lockend_remaining%`, `%lockend_remaining_seconds%`, `%lockend_unlock_at%`, `%lockend_target_time%`, `%lockend_lock_reason%`, `%lockend_reason%`, `%lockend_blocked_count%`, `%lockend_unlock_count%`, `%lockend_evacuated%`, `%lockend_schedule_action%`, `%lockend_schedule_active%`
- **MiniMessage** — Full RGB & gradient message support

### 🔧 Configuration

`plugins/EndLock/config.yml`:

- Lock state, language (8 languages)
- Broadcast notifications (actionbar or chat, scope)
- Event logging with JSON export
- Scheduled unlocks
- Join notifications
- Update checker with clickable chat link
- bStats metrics
- Integration toggles (PAPI, MiniMessage)

### 🧱 Compatibility

| Platform | Version | Support |
| -------- | ------- | ------- |
| **Paper** | 26.3+ | ✅ Recommended |
| **Purpur** | 26.3+ | ✅ Works |
| **Folia** | 26.3+ | ✅ Supported (console-verified on alpha builds) |

### 📦 Installation

1. Download `lock-end-3.1.0.jar` below
2. Place it in your `plugins/` folder
3. Restart your server (Paper or Folia 26.3+, Java 25)

### 📚 Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/vwtfafa/lock-end/blob/master/README.md) – Full docs & examples
- [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/lock-end) – Download on Modrinth
